objective: Create one shared Project Operating Guide for Claude and GPT so future agents use the same business priorities, architecture boundaries, provenance rules, testing standards, multi-agent workflow, handoff format and consolidation gates.
what_changed: Converted the multi-model Master Plan into one operational manual.
Separated Revenue, Safety/Trust and Consolidation tracks.
Added Claude implementation prompt and GPT review prompt.
Added required handoff schema, testing standard, staff UX standard and stop-doing list.
tests_not_executed: No code implementation changed; no runtime or CI tests required for this documentation artifact.
known_risks: Repository state will evolve; exact SHA/status sections must be refreshed when used as a live checkpoint.
The guide should be treated as policy/operating guidance, not a substitute for reading current code and latest repo handoffs.
recommended_next_step: Place/adapt this guide as AGENTS.md or PROJECT_GUIDE_CLAUDE_GPT.md in the relevant repos, with thin CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md pointers if desired.
requested_gpt_review: Keep the guide synchronized with the latest canonical Master Plan.
Challenge any future work that violates Revenue → Safety → Truth → Real Usage → Consolidation.

provenance.basis: Current conversation, latest multi-model Master Plan, reviewed project handoffs and current repo direction.
